nolviko.seo.title: Advanced SEO
nolviko.seo.reauth: Confirm your password first; saving SEO settings needs a confirmation from the last 15 minutes.
nolviko.seo.reauth_hint: Saving is available after a password confirmation:
nolviko.seo.aliases: Older addresses that still redirect here:
nolviko.seo.error.failed: The settings could not be saved. Try again.
nolviko.seo.error.image: The image must be a full http(s) address.
nolviko.seo.error.canonical: The canonical address must be a full http(s) address.
nolviko.seo.error.address: This address is not an indexable page of the forum (home, forum, thread, tag or gallery).
nolviko.seo.error.route_pattern_syntax: A pattern must start with / and a word (a-z, 0-9, -), and may use only its own variables in braces.
nolviko.seo.error.route_pattern_word: The first word of a pattern is already used by another page of the forum.
nolviko.seo.error.route_pattern_variable: Each pattern needs its own number variable once, e.g. {thread} for threads; {slug} is optional for threads only.
nolviko.seo.error.route_pattern_route: This page type cannot get a new address.
nolviko.seo.error.route_pattern_aliases: Too many older addresses; at most eight are kept.
nolviko.seo.error.route_pattern_conflict: With these patterns some page would answer another page's address. Choose different words.
nolviko.seo.error.extra: Extra sitemap addresses must be full addresses of this site.
nolviko.seo.error.redirect: Check the redirect: an old path other than /, a different target path or http(s) address, and 301, 302 or 410.
nolviko.seo.general_help: Title templates per page type. Placeholders: {title} (the page's own title), {site} (site name), {page} (page number). Leave empty to keep the default title.
nolviko.seo.description_template: Description for pages without one ({title} and {site} allowed)
nolviko.seo.pages_help: Paste the address of a page (home, forum, thread, tag or gallery) to give it its own title, description, keywords, image, canonical address or noindex.
nolviko.seo.page_canonical: Canonical address (full address; empty: the page's own)
nolviko.seo.addresses_help: Choose the addresses of public pages. Old addresses (the default and earlier patterns) keep working and redirect with 301, so links and search results do not break.
nolviko.seo.addresses_rules: Start with a word of your own, e.g. /konu/{slug}-{thread}, /t/{thread} or /forum/{forum}. Variables: {thread} and optional {slug} for threads, {forum}, {tag}, {album}, {item}. Leave empty for the default.
nolviko.seo.sitemap_help: Private forums never appear, whatever is chosen here.
nolviko.seo.sitemap_exclude_forums: Leave out these forums and their threads (forum numbers, comma-separated)
nolviko.seo.sitemap_extra: Extra addresses of this site (one per line)
nolviko.seo.robots_help: Core writes a safe robots.txt (private areas closed, sitemap address). Add lines to it or replace it completely.
nolviko.seo.robots_replace: Only the lines below (careful: replaces the default rules)
nolviko.seo.redirects_help: For addresses that no page answers any more: 301 (moved permanently), 302 (temporary) or 410 (removed). Existing pages always win.
